name: Ha cao
summary: A dim-sum dumpling from Tây Ninh’s Hoa kitchens, eaten with xíu mại and bánh bao as everyday food.
origin: Hoa kitchens in Tây Ninh. The cooking is Teochew and Cantonese in origin, adapted to local ingredients.
howToEat: Order it with the rest of the dim sum: há cảo, xíu mại, bánh bao, bánh bao kim sa, and chân gà hấp tàu xì.
seoDescription: Há cảo, everyday Hoa dim sum in Tây Ninh.
